# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the sequence: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Each command builds on the last. You cannot stand firm if you are not watchful. You cannot act like men if you have not first stood firm. And strength, true strength, flows from a faith that is awake and anchored.

Men, we live in a world that rewards passivity and calls it peace. It whispers that real manhood is whatever you want it to be. But Scripture calls us higher. Strength without watchfulness is reckless. Watchfulness without firmness is anxious. Firmness without courage is hollow. God designed you to be all of these at once—alert, immovable, courageous, and strong—not in your own power, but in the faith He has given you.

The battlefield is real, whether you feel it or not. Your family, your work, your integrity, your witness—all of it is under attack. So rise. Stand. Act. Be strong. Not because you are enough on your own, but because the God who called you is faithful.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, declare: "I stand firm in the faith." Finish with 60 seconds of silence, asking God to make you watchful today.
